related_questions.question: What is the reason for the pandemic?
related_questions.snippet: Any type of virus may cause a pandemic, but some are more likely to do so than others. While the COVID-19 pandemic was caused by a coronavirus, many other pandemics in the past were caused by new strains of influenza or other viruses. In a pandemic, new viruses infect lots of people and make them sick.
